name: smriti-sathi
description: Smriti Sathi — AI-driven cognitive therapeutics for dementia. Offline-first, cross-device PWA.

scripts.test:e2e:mobile: playwright test --project='Mobile Safari (iPhone 14)' --project='Tablet Safari (iPad Pro 11)' --project='Mobile Chrome (Pixel 7)'
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && open ios/App/App.xcodeproj
scripts.ios:run: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' -quiet build && xcrun simctl install 'iPhone 17 Pro' ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/App-*/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/App.app && xcrun simctl launch 'iPhone 17 Pro' com.smriti.sathi
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
